create.name: Kenlyn Kolleen
create.bio:
Kenlyn Kolleen is an astrologer and guide for people in the middle of a life change, especially women at midlife. She trained in law at Notre Dame and practised with corporate firms in Washington, D.C. and Boulder before leaving the profession, a turn she describes as moving from the boardroom to the sacred circle. She went on to found the Wise Women Collective, an online community she says has grown past 6,000 members, and has spent more than a decade teaching leaders and professionals to read the larger cycles shaping their lives.

Her approach weaves together astrology, Human Design and the Gene Keys rather than relying on any single system. In her main offering she studies a client's charts and written intake, then meets them for a long private session to name the thread running through their work so far and set out concrete next steps, followed by six months of twice-monthly group coaching. The same group programme can also be joined on its own. On YouTube she publishes regular astrology forecasts around new and full moons, eclipses and planetary transits, and she offers a free recorded training on finding steadiness and opportunity in times of upheaval.

flags: No Shift mention on own site: listed without the link.
No public base: nothing on her pages says where she lives now (see no_public_base).
Only one photo used: her YouTube avatar. Her site's card image has text over it.
YouTube pages were served to us in Portuguese with auto-translated titles; video titles were taken from YouTube oEmbed, which gave the original English titles.
Most of her YouTube channel is dated astrology forecasts for 2026; only two undated talks were kept. The most viewed videos are dated and were left out.
Email: hello@kenlynkolleen.com appears on both offer pages (kenlyn@kenlynkolleen.com also appears on the Genius Code Lab page).
Her free-training page description mentions political and social systems 'breaking down'; it reads as astrology-of-cycles framing, not partisan commentary.
left_out: Dated 2026 astrology forecast videos (moons, eclipses, Venus retrograde): not evergreen.
YouTube 'Why Midlife Brain Fog Is Really Neural Pruning | The 10-Day Body Reset Before Every Equinox': health framing.
YouTube shorts and clips under about 5 minutes with little teaching ('My psychic told me this...', 'Venus Jupiter Conjunction 2026').
The Shift Network course 'The Portal to Your Field of Super-Abundance' (2023): not mentioned on her own site.
Genius Code Fundamentals workshop: only mentioned as a bonus inside the Lab, no page of its own.
